name: Complementary Covering Framing
description: Removes the explicit independent set description ("no reported pair has both of its frequencies in the active broadcast") and reframes the problem entirely around the complement set being a hitting set/vertex cover for the edges. By presenting the constraint exclusively as a covering requirement for the unselected items, models that pattern-match for direct independent-set phrasing will struggle to map this to their standard bitmask clique/independent-set templates.
